diagnostics.message: The syncer Lambda is created with vpc_config when lambda_subnet_ids are set, but nothing orders it after the AWSLambdaVPCAccessExecutionRole attachment; if the function is created before aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.syncer_vpc_execution_role, Lambda cannot create the network interfaces and the function fails to reach Active state.

The scale-up Lambda is created with vpc_config when lambda_subnet_ids are set, but nothing orders it after the AWSLambdaVPCAccessExecutionRole attachment; if the function is created before aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.scale_up_vpc_execution_role, Lambda cannot create the network interfaces and the function fails to reach Active state.

The scale-down Lambda is created with vpc_config when lambda_subnet_ids are set, but nothing orders it after the AWSLambdaVPCAccessExecutionRole attachment; if the function is created before aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.scale_down_vpc_execution_role, Lambda cannot create the network interfaces and the function fails to reach Active state.

The webhook Lambda is created with vpc_config when lambda_subnet_ids are set, but nothing orders it after the AWSLambdaVPCAccessExecutionRole attachment; if the function is created before aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.webhook_vpc_execution_role, Lambda cannot create the network interfaces and the function fails to reach Active state.

The pool Lambda is created with vpc_config when lambda subnets are configured, but nothing orders it after the AWSLambdaVPCAccessExecutionRole attachment; if the function is created before aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.pool_vpc_execution_role, Lambda cannot create the network interfaces and the function fails to reach Active state.
